title: ampersand (&)
content:

Don't use & in place of and in text or headings unless you're referring to the use of the symbol in UI.

It's OK to use & in content for technical audiences that covers its use in HTML or programming languages.

ExampleTo display a reserved character in HTML, use a character reference, which consists of an ampersand, the code name or number of the character, and a semicolon. For example, use < or < to display the less than sign (<), and use > or > to display the greater than sign (>).

See also plus sign (+)
